Description: Area Square Kilometers: area of the feature reported in square kilometers.
Calculated Volume: volume calculated by USGS. Associated units are reported in Calculated Volume Units (Calc_V_Ut).
Calculated Volume Units: the Calculated Volume (Calc_Vol) units reported in cubic meters.
Unrepresentable: An example for this field is "cubic meters".

Description: Citation: shortened version of the reference reported in Primary Citation (Prim_Cit) or Secondary Citation (Sec_Cit). The citation includes author(s) name and publication year.
Unrepresentable: An example for this field is "Karl and others (2022)".

Description: Contained SI Commodity Amount: amount reported in the Contained field converted to metric tons, where associated units are reported in the Contained SI Commodity Unit (CntSIComUt) field. If the Material is reported as a compound, USGS staff convert to the elemental amount using stoichiometry.
Contained SI Commodity: contained commodity in the reported material. Reported as an element or chemical compound.
Contained SI Commodity Units: the Contained SI Commodity Amount (CntSIComAm) units reported in metric tons.
Unrepresentable: An example for this field is "metric tons".

Description: Commodity: produced commodity(s) reported by the source mine or the mining district.
Unrepresentable: An example for this field is "copper; gold; silver".

Description: Contained: contained commodity amount reported for the waste feature. Associated units are reported in the Contained Units (ContUnits) field. The Contained value is associated to the reported Material. If the Material is a compound, the Contained value represents the contained compound. If the Material reported is an elemental commodity, the Contained value represents the elemental form of the commodity.
Contained Units: units of the Contained commodity.
County: name of the U.S. County where the feature is located. The attribution is based on the point location.
Unrepresentable: An example for this field is "Grant".

Description: Digital Elevation Model Date: publication year of the digital elevation model used for the volume calculation.
Unrepresentable: An example for this field is "2024".

Description: Primary Deposit Type: primary reported deposit type for the site and (or) feature. Classifications are modified from Hofstra and others (2021).
Unrepresentable: An example for this field is "Calc-alkaline porphyry copper".

Description: Other Deposit Type(s): other reported deposit types for the site and (or) feature. Classifications are modified from Hofstra and others (2021).
Unrepresentable: An example for this field is "Skarn; Supergene".

Description: Feature ID: a unique alpha-numeric value assigned to each feature. The identifier includes the Site ID (Site_ID).
Unrepresentable: An example for this field is "NM000001-001".

Description: Feature Name: known name of the feature.
Unrepresentable: An example for this field is "Tailings Impoundment No. 1".

Description: Feature Type: type of waste feature.
Gangue Mineral(s): minerals identified in the cited reference(s) that were not economically desirable. In most cases, these minerals do not contain a commodity from the commodity list.
Unrepresentable: An example for this field is "biotite; calcite; chlorite; epidote; orthoclase; pyrite; quartz".

Description: Grade: reported grade of the waste feature Material. Associated units are reported in the Grade Units (Grade_Units) field. This is not the deposit grade, but the grade of the waste feature material.
Grade Units: units of Grade.
Grade SI: amount reported in the Grade field converted to International Systems of Units (SI). Associated units are reported in the Grade Units SI (GradeUntSI) field.
Grade Units SI: Units of Grade SI (GradeSI).

Land Management: surface management agency identified using the Bureau of Land Management National Surface Management Agency geodatabase (Bureau of Land Management, 2024). Attribution is based on the polygon extent.
Last Updated: date the record was last updated.
Unrepresentable: An example for this field is "2024-10-28".

Description: Latitude: latitude of point feature in decimal degrees, North American Datum 1983.
Location Description: description of how the feature was located.
Unrepresentable: An example for this field is "Digitized polygon using Esri (2024) (1)" where the primary citation located the feature and then was digitized using Esri imagery to reshape the feature to represent the current landscape. The "(1)" indicates that this is a secondary citation that is reported in the Secondary Citation (Sec_Cit) field.

Description: Longitude: longitude of point feature in decimal degrees, North American Datum 1983.
Material Amount: reported Material amount in the waste feature. Associated units are reported in the Material Units (Mat_Units) field.
Material Type: type of material reported. Material type is equivalent to Feature Type (Ftr_Type) reported in the Waste_Polygons and Waste_Points feature classes.
Unrepresentable: An example for this field is "Tailings - pond". Material types are the same as feature types. Please see the field Ftr_Type for a full list of definitions.

Description: Material Units: units of the Material Amount (Mat_Amnt).
Material Amount SI: amount reported in the Material Amount (Mat_Amnt) field converted to the International System of Units (SI) of metric tons.
Material: material reported by the source document. Material may be reported in elemental or compound form.
Unrepresentable: An example for this field is "titanium (Ti)" when reporting in elemental form, or "rutile (TiO2)" when reporting in compound form.

Description: Material Units SI: the Material Amount SI (MatAmntSI) units reported in metric tons.
Unrepresentable: An example for this field is "metric tons".

Description: Mine Name: name of the mine associated to the feature.
Unrepresentable: An example of this field is "Tyrone Mine".

Description: Mining District: name of the mining district, mineral district, area, region, belt, or similar that is related to the source material.
Unrepresentable: An example of this field is "Burro Mountains".

Description: Ore Minerals: mineral(s) identified in the cited reference(s) that is a commodity, or contains an element from the Commodity field, that could be economically viable for production and recovery.
Unrepresentable: An example of this field is "chalcopyrite; molybdenite". Where the commodities of copper and molybdenum are reported.

Description: Other Names: other reported names of the mine waste feature.
Unrepresentable: An example of this field is "Tailing Pond 6E; Tailing Pond 6W".

Description: Primary Citation: shortened version of the primary citation. Identification includes author name(s) and publication year.
Unrepresentable: An example of this field is "Simmons (2013)" for a single author, "North and McLemore (1986)" for two authors, and "McLemore and others (2021)" for more than two authors.

Description: Reference: full reference of the associated Citation.
Unrepresentable: An example of this field is "McLemore, V.T., 2017, Mining districts and prospect areas in New Mexico: New Mexico Bureau Mines Mineral Resources Resource Map 24, 65 p., https://doi.org/10.58799/RM-24.".

Description: Reclaimed: value that indicates if a waste feature has been fully reclaimed.
Unrepresentable: An example of this field is "Yes" if the feature has been fully reclaimed, and "No" if the feature has been partially reclaimed, or has not undergone reclamation.

Description: Remarks: field that contains general remarks not accommodated by the data structure.
Unrepresentable: An example of this field is "Deposit known as Santa Rita".

Description: Reported volume: reported volume of the waste feature. Associated units are reported in the Reported Volume Units (Rep_V_Ut) field.

Reported Volume SI: amount reported in the Reported Volume (Rep_Vol) field converted to International System of Units (SI). Associated units are reported in the Reported Volume Units SI (Rep_Vut_SI) field.
Reported Volume Units: units of the Reported Volume (Rep_Vol).
Reported Volume Units SI: units in cubic meters of the Reported Volume SI (Rep_Vol_SI).
Unrepresentable: An example of this field is "cubic meters".

Description: Resource Classification: resource classification reported in the source document.
Resource Code: standard classification system used to classify and report the resource estimate.
Resource Date: year the resource was estimated.
Resource Method: a brief description of the resource method.
Unrepresentable: An example of this field is "Resource defined by 30-RC drill holes".

Description: Secondary Citation(s): shortened version of the secondary citation. Identification includes author name(s) and publication year.
Unrepresentable: An example of this field is "(1) Karl (2022); (2) Karl (2023)".

Description: Site ID: an alpha-numeric identification assigned to a site.
Unrepresentable: An example of this field is "NM000001".

Description: Site Name: name that best represents the grouping of features.
Unrepresentable: An example of this field is "Tyrone".

Description: State: the 2-letter abbreviation of the U.S. State where the feature is located. The attribution is based on the point location.
Unrepresentable: An example of this field is "NM".

Description: Superfund: value that indicates if the feature has been declared or proposed as a U.S. Environmental Protection Agency Superfund site.
Unrepresentable: An example of this field is "Yes" if the feature is a Superfund site and "No" if the feature has not been a Superfund site.

Description: Tonnage Factor: the tonnage factor is a specific value used based upon density that converts volume of material to a tonnage weight. Associated units are reported in the Tonnage Factor Units (Ton_F_Ut) field.
Tonnage Factor Units: units of the Tonnage Factor (Ton_Factor).
Tonnage Factor SI: amount reported in Tonnage Factor (Ton_Factor) converted to International System of Units (SI). Associated units are reported in the Tonnage Factor SI Units (Ton_F_SI_U) field.
Tonnage Factor SI Units: units of Tonnage Factor SI (Ton_F_SI).
Topo Name: USGS topographic map name provided on the 7.5-minute quadrangle. The attribution is based on the point location.
Unrepresentable: An example of this field is "Wind Mountain".
